Run many games and compare strategies

Source: R/ai.R
rk_tournament.Rd

Repeatedly deals a fresh game and plays it out with rk_play(), then summarises how often each strategy won.

Usage

rk_tournament(
  policies,
  n_games = 20L,
  map = rk_world(),
  max_rounds = 100L,
  seed = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

policies

A named character vector of strategy names, one per player, for example c(Red = "aggressive", Blue = "cautious").

n_games

Number of games to play.

map

An rk_map object to play on. Defaults to rk_world().

max_rounds

Maximum number of rounds to play before stopping.

seed

Optional whole number seed. Supplying it calls set.seed() and therefore resets the caller's random number stream.

verbose

A flag: report each completed round with cli::cli_alert()?

Value

A tibble::tibble() with one row per player and columns player (character), strategy (character), games (integer), wins (integer), win_rate (double), mean_territories (double, territories held when the games ended) and mean_rounds (double, the average game length, repeated on every row).

See also

Other ai: rk_ai(), rk_play()

Examples

# \donttest{
rk_tournament(
  c(Red = "aggressive", Blue = "cautious"),
  n_games = 2, max_rounds = 10, seed = 1
)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 7
#>   player strategy   games  wins win_rate mean_territories mean_rounds
#>   <chr>  <chr>      <int> <int>    <dbl>            <dbl>       <dbl>
#> 1 Red    aggressive     2     0        0                0           5
#> 2 Blue   cautious       2     2        1               42           5
# }
